text=FR2.5 - The system shall allow the

text=FR2.6 - The dispenser kiosk shall release a wristband
only after reading the QR code of a paid, not yet collected
ticket, or of a replacement requested through the app (FR2.5),
binding the wristband to that ticket.
text=FR2.7 - The system shall allow an authenticated attendant
to block a lost wristband and encode a new one for the visitor,
after confirming their identity through the app or a photo ID,
transferring the ticket, remaining priority queue credits,
balance, linked card, rented locker, guardian links and in-park
presence status (so that anti-passback is not violated).
text=FR2.8 - Turnstiles, gates, lockers and points
of sale shall reject a blocked identifier; offline
devices shall start rejecting it as soon as they
receive the block list during synchronization.
text=FR2.9 - The system shall record every wristband
replacement with the responsible attendant, timestamp,
old and new identifiers and the transferred items.

text=FR4 - The system shall manage the digital wallet and wristband payments.
text=FR4.1 - The system shall allow the
prepaid wristband balance to be topped up
through the app, via Pix, debit or credit.
text=FR4.2 - The system shall allow a credit or
debit card to be linked through the app,
tokenized by the gateway, so that the
wristband works as a contactless payment
